column1: # The budget of every producer (scripts/cmux-next/perf-budget-table.py; the perf cron's report prints "Budget: N over, N not measured").
# A row: name, producer, most (the limit: a value above it is OVER), unit, rows (a full-match regex over the perf cron's row names, host
# left off; empty: no harness feeds the cron yet), max_age_h (a value older than this is NOT MEASURED), harness, what.
# The row's value is the worst (largest) newest value of the matching rows on any host. A row with no value (no harness, the harness
# printed nothing, or its newest value is too old) is NOT MEASURED, never a pass. The target is "0 over, 0 not measured".
# Limits: a limit perf-budgets.json, perf-cron.py or bundle-size-budget.json already has is used as it is ("existing"); a limit
# from the frame-pipeline lab's design (its ARCHITECTURE.md 5.4, 15.2) says so ("lab"); a new limit with no prior target is a REGRESSION limit just above
# the first values the cron has (the lab's form of its scripts/budgets.tsv, "regression limit"), to be lowered when a target is set.
